# SARIF 2.1.0 JSON schema

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 (Errata 01) schema,
copied unmodified from
[oasis-tcs/sarif-spec](https://github.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/blob/25eb7663ad3ac54338b4f6a00a7004995e32e6da/sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json)
at commit `25eb7663ad3ac54338b4f6a00a7004995e32e6da`
(sha256 `c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e`).
Its canonical location is
<https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json>.

It is used only by `tests/sarif.rs` and is not part of the oxiclean binary.

and update the commit and checksum above.
